title: Vaerion broker decision record (v1)
description: The journaled record of a PermissionBroker evaluation (ADR-0004). Law: fail-closed — un-evaluable requests deny with E1301, never allow-by-default (constitution D-A); decide -> journal -> act — a privileged action fires only after this record exists in the journal (E1304 otherwise); every decision, allow or deny, lands in the audit ledger (Refusal Log, D-L). Action payloads are redacted before journaling: decisions never carry secrets.

request_id.description: ULID of the originating decision request.

trace_id.description: Trace the decision occurred within; links `vae explain <trace>` to this record.

principal.description: Who requested the privileged operation. The broker mediates identically for every principal kind.

id.description: CRN or stable id, e.g. crn_run_01J..., crn_ext_<ulid>, or local-user.

runId.description: Owning run for agent/research principals (transient trust).

digest.description: Artifact digest pinned in vaerion.lock, for extension principals.

domain.description: Capability domain requested. v1 vocabulary: fs.read, fs.write, net.connect, exec.run, model.invoke, secret.read, tool.call, intel.query, research.index, research.fetch, journal.append, journal.read.

scope.description: Requested scope within the domain (target path, host, or tool pattern).

intent.description: Stated reason the action is needed. Required: empty intent is not evaluable, and un-evaluable fails closed.

action.description: The request's action parameters, redacted before journaling (decisions never carry secrets). Optional: present when the caller supplied an action payload.

decision.description: The decision body. Exactly one of allow / deny / prompt.

policy.description: Identifier of the policy rule that allowed the request.

reason_code.description: E1300: denied by policy. E1301: could not be evaluated — broker failed closed.

reason.description: Human-readable denial reason (for E1300, the policy rationale; for E1301, the fail-closed explanation).

policy.description: Denying policy rule, or the policy's default-deny sentinel for E1301.

gate_id.description: Durable gate awaiting human authority (see spec/schemas/gate.schema.json).

reason.description: Gate label or policy rationale shown to the human.

resolved_by.description: Authority that resolved a prompt decision: a human through a gate, or policy (for example a timeout rule). Present only after resolution.

resolved_answer.description: Human-authority input captured at resolution (redacted). Present only after resolution.
